+# R3 最终来源摘要校准候选
+
+本候选基于 `c0f62d973180679134f2eb1a488c1dc359c8658f`，接收固定独立报告 `34202eb7accfee48bb8761db88b340bd77f54a42` 的两项 P3、七行当前来源摘要修正。独立报告已判分类、职责、范围、依赖四 facet 全部736行 PASS、原R2七项问题 PASS；其当前来源校准为729 PASS/7 FAIL。本轮只完成作者修复，七行校准仍须父任务另建真正非作者 ultra/default 复核。
+
+| 根因 | 行 | 当前摘要 |
+| --- | --- | --- |
+| R3-SOURCE-ATTRIBUTION-001 | 173 | WP26 记录战斗收服存储空操作；回放另按WP58副本、实时依赖及正常终局/中止合同。 |
+| 同根 | 227 | WP36 接受负概率/负累加器，整数商向下取整且不钳零。 |
+| 同根 | 596 | WP61 Repel 默认首非蛋（含濒死），替代首可战成员。 |
+| R3-EV-BOUNDARY-001 | 29/204/456 | HP/攻击255、总量510，超过单项252；HP首项负余量失败，未到总量夹限与本接收者写入。 |
+| 同根 | 32 | WP42 外层正常返回及结束通知后复位行走动画状态/转向预锁记录。 |
+
+[逐字段原值/新值及固定源](correction-record.json)绑定七个精确 `differences/1` 指针；主清单其余值全部相等。相应七条单元证据、六份文件级摘要/未来边界、统一补丁七个after值、可复用生成输入及七行当前facet记录同步。[作者精确证明](repair-proof.json)核固定5f单元与文件身份、完整对象/序列化字节重建、历史writer保护及写入范围。生成器仍拒绝对最终清单重跑历史写入步骤。
+
+不可变source/current/upstream、稳定ID、退役体、33metadata、职责、依赖、类别、阶段与未验证状态保留。131文档/87WP、历史2683/当前2704标题、九接受事件及230绑定清零继续核验。原35175归档、原应用回执、R1/R2历史及正式B8工作树原字节保留；当前源只从 `5f87743293290de2e219ecdd6c19e88280f60c9a` Git对象读取。未运行Ruby、参考游戏、业务场景、宿主或四类原型。
+
+静态回归入口为原 `../r3/tools/run-author-checks.py --phase cumulative-source`、`../r3/tools/final-calibration-proof.py --output ...` 与本目录 `check-repair.py`；[后继真实I/O](command-io.json)记录实际命令、UTC、stdout/stderr、exit及输入哈希。原十命令的明细结果仍在 `../r3/tools/actual-command-io.json`。初次环境缺jsonschema的观察和隔离依赖安装与正式回归分开登记，不把准备失败改写为PASS。
+
+[相对c0的精确文件差分](changes-from-c0.json)、[主清单统一diff](manifest-from-c0.diff)、根候选身份表在冻结后写入。自身哈希排除项由最终Git提交绑定，父交接给精确40位SHA，避免未来自身哈希循环。[有界复核入口](review-prompt.md)保留既有PASS信用并复核七行及必要传播。普通push后须全新、无alternates回读远端提交的打标目录全文；不修改原任务分支或main，不force、不merge。
+
+全部736去向仍待验证、阶段待定/未批准、未实现/未验收；框架307/Showdown74/协作130/MZ225/排除0，CLOSED0。目标版本、原型和用户范围/阶段决定由协调任务后续处理。请求gpt-6.1-sol/xhigh/default，实际运行配置缺权威echo，保持UNVERIFIED。

--- c0f62d973180679134f2eb1a488c1dc359c8658f:planning/implementation-routing/r8-20261017/revisions/r3-calibration-repair/check-repair.py
+++ 7ed3e0554ac24339a7e61cab152f628037111644:planning/implementation-routing/r8-20261017/revisions/r3-calibration-repair/check-repair.py
@@ -0,0 +1,172 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Prove exact seven-leaf repair, source binding and complete patch reconstruction."""
+import argparse
+import ast
+import copy
+import gzip
+import hashlib
+import importlib.util
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+import subprocess
+import sys
+
+sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
+HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+INV = HERE.parents[1]
+ROOT = INV.parents[2]
+BASE = 'c0f62d973180679134f2eb1a488c1dc359c8658f'
+REVIEW = '34202eb7accfee48bb8761db88b340bd77f54a42'
+SOURCE = '5f87743293290de2e219ecdd6c19e88280f60c9a'
+PREFIX = str(INV.relative_to(ROOT)) + '/'
+
+
+def git(*args):
+    return subprocess.check_output(['git', *args], cwd=ROOT)
+
+
+def sha(data):
+    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
+
+
+def load(path):
+    return json.loads(path.read_bytes())
+
+
+def save(path, value):
+    path.write_text(json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n')
+
+
+def differences(a, b, pointer=''):
+    if type(a) != type(b):
+        return [pointer]
+    if isinstance(a, dict):
+        assert a.keys() == b.keys(), pointer
+        return [p for k in a for p in differences(a[k], b[k], pointer + '/' + k)]
+    if isinstance(a, list):
+        assert len(a) == len(b), pointer
+        return [p for i, (x, y) in enumerate(zip(a, b)) for p in differences(x, y, pointer + '/' + str(i))]
+    return [pointer] if a != b else []
+
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument('--output', type=Path, default=HERE / 'repair-proof.json')
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    receipt = load(HERE / 'correction-record.json')
+    before_bytes = git('show', BASE + ':' + PREFIX + 'routing-manifest.json')
+    current_bytes = (INV / 'routing-manifest.json').read_bytes()
+    before = json.loads(before_bytes)
+    current = json.loads(current_bytes)
+    changes = differences(before, current)
+    assert sorted(changes) == sorted(r['pointer'] for r in receipt['records'])
+    assert sha(before_bytes) == receipt['manifest_before_sha256']
+    assert sha(current_bytes) == receipt['manifest_after_sha256']
+    fs = {f['feature_id']: f for f in current['features']}
+    delta = {r['feature_id']: r for r in load(INV / 'revisions/r3/feature-source-deltas.json')['records']}
+    files = {r['document']: r for r in load(INV / 'revisions/r3/source-file-reassessment.json')['records']}
+    module = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('repair_inputs', HERE / 'repair-seven-narratives.py')
+    repair = importlib.util.module_from_spec(module)
+    module.loader.exec_module(repair)
+    source_results = []
+    for row in receipt['records']:
+        fid = row['feature_id']
+        src = row['fixed_source']
+        raw = git('show', SOURCE + ':' + src['document'])
+        lines = raw.decode().splitlines(keepends=True)
+        unit = ''.join(''.join(lines[a-1:b]) for a, b in src['line_ranges']).encode()
+        assert sha(raw) == src['file_sha256']
+        assert sha(unit) == src['unit_sha256']
+        assert hashlib.sha1(b'blob ' + str(len(raw)).encode() + b'\0' + raw).hexdigest() == src['file_git_blob']
+        assert fs[fid]['differences'][1] == row['after']
+        assert delta[fid]['source_fact_delta'] == repair.FACTS[fid]
+        name = Path(src['document']).name
+        assert files[src['document']]['source_fact_reassessment'] == repair.FILE_FACTS[name]
+        assert files[src['document']]['future_plan_reassessment'] == delta[fid]['future_boundary_reassessment'] == repair.BOUNDARIES[name]
+        source_results.append({'feature_id': fid, 'source_identity_matches_fixed_git': True,
+                               'complete_effective_ranges': src['line_ranges'], 'unit_sha256': sha(unit)})
+    archive_path = INV / 'revisions/r3/tools/post-source-pre-semantic-35175c7094b0.json.gz'
+    archived = gzip.decompress(archive_path.read_bytes())
+    patch_path = INV / 'revisions/r3/source-refinement-patch.json'
+    patch = load(patch_path)
+    old_patch = json.loads(git('show', BASE + ':' + PREFIX + 'revisions/r3/source-refinement-patch.json'))
+    assert sha(archived) == patch['input_manifest_sha256']
+    assert archive_path.read_bytes() == git('show', BASE + ':' + PREFIX + str(archive_path.relative_to(INV)))
+    expected_patch = copy.deepcopy(old_patch)
+    for row in expected_patch['records']:
+        if row['feature_id'] in repair.FACTS:
+            next(c for c in row['field_changes'] if c['pointer'] == '/differences')['after'] = fs[row['feature_id']]['differences']
+    assert patch == expected_patch, 'Only the seven declared patch after-values may change'
+    expected = json.loads(archived)
+    expected_fs = {f['feature_id']: f for f in expected['features']}
+    for row in patch['records']:
+        for change in row['field_changes']:
+            obj = expected_fs[row['feature_id']]
+            parts = change['pointer'].strip('/').split('/')
+            for part in parts[:-1]:
+                obj = obj[part]
+            assert obj[parts[-1]] == change['before']
+            obj[parts[-1]] = copy.deepcopy(change['after'])
+    expected_bytes = (json.dumps(expected, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n').encode()
+    assert expected == current and expected_bytes == current_bytes
+    generator = (INV / 'revisions/r3/build-author-evidence.py').read_text()
+    old_generator = git('show', BASE + ':' + PREFIX + 'revisions/r3/build-author-evidence.py').decode()
+    assert generator.splitlines()[:7] == old_generator.splitlines()[:7]
+    tree = ast.parse(generator)
+    assignments = {n.targets[0].id: n.value for n in tree.body if isinstance(n, ast.Assign) and isinstance(n.targets[0], ast.Name)}
+    manual = ast.literal_eval(assignments['manual'])
+    units = ast.literal_eval(assignments['unit_narratives'])
+    for name in repair.FILE_FACTS:
+        assert manual[name] == (repair.FILE_FACTS[name], repair.BOUNDARIES[name])
+    assert units == {k: repair.FACTS[k] for k in ['FR-000029', 'FR-000032']}
+    for name in ['author-refinement-application.json', 'source-narrative-correction.json']:
+        assert (INV / 'revisions/r3' / name).read_bytes() == git('show', BASE + ':' + PREFIX + 'revisions/r3/' + name)
+    for name in ['facet-inheritance.json', 'feature-resolution.json']:
+        data = load(INV / 'revisions/r3' / name)
+        old_data = json.loads(git('show', BASE + ':' + PREFIX + 'revisions/r3/' + name))
+        expected_data = copy.deepcopy(old_data)
+        key = 'records' if name.startswith('facet') else 'active_feature_results'
+        byid = {r['feature_id']: r for r in data[key]}
+        for row in expected_data[key]:
+            if row['feature_id'] in repair.FACTS:
+                row['current_calibration_repair'] = byid[row['feature_id']]['current_calibration_repair']
+                assert row['current_calibration_repair']['author_status'] == 'CORRECTED_AWAITING_INDEPENDENT_REVIEW'
+        assert data == expected_data
+    changed_paths = set(git('diff', '--name-only', BASE).decode().splitlines())
+    changed_paths.update(git('ls-files', '--others', '--exclude-standard').decode().splitlines())
+    assert all(p.startswith(PREFIX) for p in changed_paths)
+    assert not git('diff', BASE, '--', 'deliverables/final-specification-set', 'reference')
+    checks = {
+        'exact_seven_manifest_leaf_changes_only': True,
+        'all_other_manifest_values_preserved': True,
+        'seven_source_units_match_actual_5f_git': True,
+        'unit_and_file_evidence_synchronized': True,
+        'original_35175_archive_and_application_receipts_byte_preserved': True,
+        'only_seven_consolidated_patch_after_values_changed': True,
+        'complete_manifest_object_and_serialized_bytes_reconstructed': True,
+        'reusable_generator_fact_boundary_and_unit_overrides_synchronized': True,
+        'historical_writer_fixed_input_guard_unchanged': True,
+        'only_seven_current_facet_resolution_rows_extended': True,
+        'only_independent_routing_directory_changed': True,
+        'formal_and_reference_diff_empty': True,
+    }
+    result = {'schema_version': 'routing-r3-seven-repair-proof.v1',
+              'role': 'AUTHOR_EXACT_CHANGE_AND_STATIC_STRUCTURE_ONLY; independent semantic acceptance pending',
+              'fixed_candidate': BASE, 'fixed_review': REVIEW, 'current_source': SOURCE,
+              'manifest_sha256': sha(current_bytes), 'patch_sha256': sha(patch_path.read_bytes()),
+              'manifest_changed_pointers': changes, 'source_results': source_results,

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Freeze exact file deltas and candidate identities without self-hash cycles."""
+import datetime
+import hashlib
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+import subprocess
+import sys
+
+sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
+HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+INV = HERE.parents[1]
+ROOT = INV.parents[2]
+BASE = 'c0f62d973180679134f2eb1a488c1dc359c8658f'
+R2 = 'a32873d2860b15d9f5e27727db8f131f4ec433b6'
+BRANCH = 'codex/r8-r3-seven-line-recovery-20261017'
+PREFIX = str(INV.relative_to(ROOT)) + '/'
+
+
+def git(*args):
+    return subprocess.check_output(['git', *args], cwd=ROOT)
+
+
+def identity(data):
+    try:
+        lines = len(data.decode('utf-8').splitlines())
+    except UnicodeDecodeError:
+        lines = None
+    return {'bytes': len(data), 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(), 'lines': lines,
+            'git_blob': hashlib.sha1(b'blob '+str(len(data)).encode()+b'\0'+data).hexdigest()}
+
+
+def save(path, value):
+    path.write_text(json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)+'\n')
+
+
+def main():
+    assert git('branch', '--show-current').decode().strip() == BRANCH
+    assert git('rev-parse', 'HEAD').decode().strip() == BASE
+    changed = set(git('diff', '--name-only', BASE).decode().splitlines())
+    changed.update(git('ls-files', '--others', '--exclude-standard').decode().splitlines())
+    assert all(p.startswith(PREFIX) for p in changed), sorted(changed)
+    assert not git('diff', BASE, '--', 'deliverables/final-specification-set', 'reference')
+    refs = git('ls-remote', 'origin', 'refs/heads/main', 'refs/heads/codex/r8-disposition-tagging-20261017', 'refs/heads/'+BRANCH).decode().splitlines()
+    remote = {line.split('\t')[1]: line.split('\t')[0] for line in refs}
+    assert 'refs/heads/'+BRANCH not in remote, 'Recovery remote branch already exists; inspect before writing.'
+    assert git('rev-parse', BASE+':deliverables/final-specification-set').decode().strip() == 'f292698cdd4a8e725525a9be6dc34b75faaf151e'
+    assert json.loads((HERE/'command-io.json').read_bytes())['all_commands_exit_zero']
+    assert json.loads((HERE/'repair-proof.json').read_bytes())['all_passed']
+    save(HERE/'pre-publication-protection.json', {
+        'schema_version':'routing-r3-repair-publication-protection.v1', 'utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
+        'branch':BRANCH, 'base_candidate':BASE, 'remote_before_publication':remote,
+        'formal_tree':'f292698cdd4a8e725525a9be6dc34b75faaf151e', 'formal_and_reference_diff_empty':True,
+        'changed_paths_outside_routing':[], 'authorized_action':'Ordinary push of this new independent branch only; no force, main/original-branch mutation or merge.',
+        'post_push_requirement':'Fresh independent no-alternates clone, exact new commit, full-byte read of every routing file including self-excluded identity artifacts.',
+        'all_passed':True})
+    manifest_path = INV/'candidate-file-manifest.json'
+    r2_delta = INV/'revisions/r3/changes-from-r2.json'
+    c0_delta = HERE/'changes-from-c0.json'
+    excluded = {str(p.relative_to(ROOT)) for p in [manifest_path, r2_delta, c0_delta]}
+    current_paths = {str(p.relative_to(ROOT)):p for p in INV.rglob('*') if p.is_file() and '__pycache__' not in p.parts}
+    for commit, output in [(R2,r2_delta),(BASE,c0_delta)]:
+        prior_paths = git('ls-tree','-r','--name-only',commit,'--',str(INV.relative_to(ROOT))).decode().splitlines()
+        prior = {p:identity(git('show',commit+':'+p)) for p in prior_paths if p not in excluded}
+        changes=[]
+        for path in sorted((set(prior)|set(current_paths))-excluded):
+            old=prior.get(path)
+            cur=identity(current_paths[path].read_bytes()) if path in current_paths else None
+            if old!=cur:
+                assert cur is not None, 'No deletion authorized: '+path
+                changes.append({'path':path,'change':'ADD' if old is None else 'MODIFY','previous':old,'current':cur})
+        save(output, {'schema_version':'routing-r3-repair-exact-file-delta.v1','previous_candidate':commit,
+            'current_commit_binding':'Final40-hex Git commit supplied by author handoff; no future self SHA.',
+            'identity_exclusions':{'paths':sorted(excluded),'reason':'Both file deltas and enclosing manifest exclude cross/self hashes; exact final Git commit independently binds all three. Candidate manifest includes both deltas.'},
+            'manifest_semantic_delta':'Exactly seven differences/1 leaves relative toc0; archive-to-final cumulative patch remains78 rows/162 fields.',
+            'counts':{'changed_payload_files':len(changes),'added':sum(c['change']=='ADD' for c in changes),'modified':sum(c['change']=='MODIFY' for c in changes),'deleted':0},
+            'files':changes})
+    paths=sorted(p for p in INV.rglob('*') if p.is_file() and '__pycache__' not in p.parts and p!=manifest_path)
+    entries=[{'path':str(p.relative_to(ROOT)),**identity(p.read_bytes())} for p in paths]
+    save(manifest_path, {'schema_version':'routing-candidate-file-manifest.v4','source_delivery_commit':'4575e80d041ab0c74a42e2e36399d05791dbaa5b',
+        'previous_candidate':BASE,'previous_R2_candidate':R2,
+        'candidate_commit_binding':'Final40-hex Git commit supplied by author handoff; no future self SHA.',
+        'self_identity':'Excluded from own entries; verify exact blob and all bytes from final fixed Git commit.',
+        'binary_line_count':'lines:null for binary; bytes/sha256/git_blob remain exact.',
+        'files':entries,'payload_file_count':len(entries)})
+    for row in entries:
+        assert identity((ROOT/row['path']).read_bytes()) == {k:row[k] for k in ['bytes','sha256','lines','git_blob']}
+    print(json.dumps({'payload_files':len(entries),'total_routing_files':len(entries)+1,
+                      'changes_from_c0':json.loads(c0_delta.read_bytes())['counts'],
+                      'remote_before_publication':remote,'all_file_identities_verified':True},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
+
+
+if __name__=='__main__':
+    main()

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Capture real bounded follow-up I/O after the unchanged ten-command suite."""
+import datetime
+import hashlib
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import time
+
+sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
+HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+INV = HERE.parents[1]
+ROOT = INV.parents[2]
+
+
+def stamp():
+    return datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
+
+
+def hashes():
+    paths = ['routing-manifest.json', 'routing.py', 'revisions/r3/source-refinement-patch.json',
+             'revisions/r3/feature-source-deltas.json', 'revisions/r3/source-file-reassessment.json',
+             'revisions/r3/build-author-evidence.py', 'revisions/r3/facet-inheritance.json',
+             'revisions/r3/feature-resolution.json', 'revisions/r3-calibration-repair/correction-record.json',
+             'revisions/r3-calibration-repair/check-repair.py', 'revisions/r3-calibration-repair/run-repair-checks.py']
+    return {p: hashlib.sha256((INV / p).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in paths}
+
+
+def main():
+    suite_path = INV / 'revisions/r3/tools/actual-command-io.json'
+    suite = json.loads(suite_path.read_bytes())
+    assert len(suite['commands']) == 10 and suite['all_commands_exit_zero'] and suite['all_input_hashes_stable']
+    assert suite['initial_input_sha256']['routing-manifest.json'] == hashes()['routing-manifest.json']
+    record = {'schema_version': 'routing-r3-bounded-repair-command-io.v1',
+              'role': 'AUTHOR_STATIC_IO_ONLY_NOT_INDEPENDENT_REVIEW', 'started_utc': stamp(),
+              'working_directory': str(ROOT), 'python': sys.executable,
+              'preparation_observation': {'initial_python': 'python3',
+                  'observed_first_validate_failure': "ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'jsonschema'",
+                  'original_observation': 'Tool execution before the retained suite; no exact start/end timestamp asserted for that preliminary invocation.',
+                  'resolved_by': 'Isolated /tmp/r3-repair-venv with jsonschema4.26.0; no project/system dependency edit.'},
+              'unchanged_ten_command_suite': {'path': str(suite_path.relative_to(INV)),
+                  'sha256': hashlib.sha256(suite_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
+                  'started_utc': suite['started_utc'], 'completed_utc': suite['completed_utc'],
+                  'commands': suite['commands'], 'all_commands_exit_zero': True, 'all17_input_hashes_stable': True},
+              'initial_input_sha256': hashes(), 'commands': []}
+    commands = [[sys.executable, str(HERE / 'check-repair.py')],
+                [sys.executable, str(INV / 'revisions/r3/tools/final-calibration-proof.py'),
+                 '--output', str(INV / 'revisions/r3/tools/final-calibration-proof.json')]]
+    for argv in commands:
+        item = {'argv': argv, 'started_utc': stamp(), 'input_sha256_before': hashes()}
+        start = time.monotonic()
+        result = subprocess.run(argv, cwd=ROOT, text=True, capture_output=True)
+        item.update(ended_utc=stamp(), elapsed_seconds=round(time.monotonic()-start, 3),
+                    exit_code=result.returncode, stdout=result.stdout, stderr=result.stderr,
+                    input_sha256_after=hashes())
+        record['commands'].append(item)
+        record['completed_utc'] = stamp()
+        record['all_commands_exit_zero'] = len(record['commands']) == 2 and all(c['exit_code'] == 0 for c in record['commands'])
+        record['all_input_hashes_stable'] = all(c['input_sha256_before'] == c['input_sha256_after'] == record['initial_input_sha256'] for c in record['commands'])
+        (HERE / 'command-io.json').write_text(json.dumps(record, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)+'\n')
+        print(json.dumps({'command': Path(argv[1]).name, 'exit_code': result.returncode,
+                          'elapsed_seconds': item['elapsed_seconds']}, ensure_ascii=False), flush=True)
+        if result.returncode or not record['all_input_hashes_stable']:
+            print(result.stdout)
+            print(result.stderr, file=sys.stderr)
+            return 1
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    sys.exit(main())

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Fresh remote-only full-byte readback of the published routing candidate."""
+import argparse
+import datetime
+import hashlib
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+import subprocess
+import tempfile
+
+HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+INV = HERE.parents[1]
+ROOT = INV.parents[2]
+PREFIX = str(INV.relative_to(ROOT)) + '/'
+BASE = 'c0f62d973180679134f2eb1a488c1dc359c8658f'
+BRANCH = 'codex/r8-r3-seven-line-recovery-20261017'
+URL = 'https://github.com/y805939188/pokemon-essentials-clean-room.git'
+
+
+def identity(data):
+    try:
+        lines = len(data.decode().splitlines())
+    except UnicodeDecodeError:
+        lines = None
+    return {'bytes':len(data),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),'lines':lines,
+            'git_blob':hashlib.sha1(b'blob '+str(len(data)).encode()+b'\0'+data).hexdigest()}
+
+
+def main():
+    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument('--sha',required=True)
+    parser.add_argument('--output',type=Path,required=True)
+    args=parser.parse_args()
+    assert len(args.sha)==40 and all(c in '0123456789abcdef' for c in args.sha)
+    commands=[]
+    def run(argv,cwd,input=None):
+        start=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
+        done=subprocess.run(argv,cwd=cwd,input=input,capture_output=True)
+        commands.append({'argv':argv,'started_utc':start,'ended_utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
+                         'exit_code':done.returncode,'stdin_sha256':hashlib.sha256(input).hexdigest() if input else None,
+                         'stdout_bytes':len(done.stdout),'stdout_sha256':hashlib.sha256(done.stdout).hexdigest(),
+                         'stderr':done.stderr.decode(errors='replace')})
+        done.check_returncode()
+        return done.stdout
+    result={'schema_version':'routing-r3-repair-remote-full-readback.v1','candidate':args.sha,
+            'base_candidate':BASE,'branch':BRANCH,'started_utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
+            'acquisition':'New remote-only shallow blob-filtered clone; no local alternates or shared objects.'}
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='r3-remote-readback-') as tmp:
+        tmp=Path(tmp)
+        run(['git','clone','--quiet','--filter=blob:none','--depth=1','--single-branch','--branch',BRANCH,'--no-checkout',URL,'remote'],tmp)
+        fresh=tmp/'remote'
+        assert not (fresh/'.git/objects/info/alternates').exists()
+        assert run(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],fresh).decode().strip()==args.sha
+        commit=run(['git','cat-file','commit',args.sha],fresh).decode()
+        assert [l.split()[1] for l in commit.split('\n\n')[0].splitlines() if l.startswith('parent ')]==[BASE]
+        tree=run(['git','ls-tree','-r',args.sha,'--',PREFIX.rstrip('/')],fresh).decode().splitlines()
+        records=[]
+        for line in tree:
+            meta,path=line.split('\t',1);mode,kind,blob=meta.split();assert kind=='blob'
+            records.append({'path':path,'mode':mode,'blob':blob})
+        # Explicit blob wants hydrate the entire bounded routing directory in one transfer.
+        wants=''.join(oid+'\n' for oid in sorted({r['blob'] for r in records})).encode()
+        run(['git','-c','fetch.negotiationAlgorithm=noop','fetch','--quiet','--filter=blob:none','--no-tags','--no-write-fetch-head','origin','--stdin'],fresh,wants)
+        requests=''.join(r['blob']+'\n' for r in records).encode()
+        raw=run(['git','cat-file','--batch'],fresh,requests)
+        offset=0;contents={};files=[]
+        for row in records:
+            end=raw.index(b'\n',offset);header=raw[offset:end].decode().split();oid,kind,size=header;size=int(size)
+            assert oid==row['blob'] and kind=='blob'
+            data=raw[end+1:end+1+size];offset=end+1+size
+            assert raw[offset:offset+1]==b'\n';offset+=1
+            info=identity(data);assert info['git_blob']==row['blob']
+            assert data==(ROOT/row['path']).read_bytes(),row['path']
+            contents[row['path']]=data
+            files.append({'path':row['path'],'mode':row['mode'],**info,'local_bytes_equal':True})
+        assert offset==len(raw)
+        manifest_name=PREFIX+'candidate-file-manifest.json'
+        manifest=json.loads(contents[manifest_name])
+        assert {r['path'] for r in manifest['files']}==set(contents)-{manifest_name}
+        for row in manifest['files']:
+            assert identity(contents[row['path']])=={k:row[k] for k in ['bytes','sha256','lines','git_blob']}
+        formal=run(['git','rev-parse',args.sha+':deliverables/final-specification-set'],fresh).decode().strip()
+        assert formal=='f292698cdd4a8e725525a9be6dc34b75faaf151e'
+        before=json.loads(contents[PREFIX+'revisions/r3-calibration-repair/pre-publication-protection.json'])['remote_before_publication']
+        refs=run(['git','ls-remote','origin','refs/heads/main','refs/heads/codex/r8-disposition-tagging-20261017','refs/heads/'+BRANCH],fresh).decode().splitlines()
+        remote={line.split('\t')[1]:line.split('\t')[0] for line in refs}
+        assert all(remote[k]==v for k,v in before.items())
+        assert remote['refs/heads/'+BRANCH]==args.sha
+        result.update(files=files,total_files=len(files),total_bytes=sum(r['bytes'] for r in files),
+                      candidate_identity_manifest_including_self_fully_read=True,
+                      all_remote_and_local_file_bytes_equal=True,all_candidate_manifest_entries_match=True,
+                      new_commit_parent_exactly_c0=True,formal_tree=formal,main_and_original_author_refs_unchanged=True,
+                      remote_after_publication=remote,commands=commands,all_passed=True,
+                      completed_utc=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat())
+    args.output.write_text(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
+    print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in result.items() if k not in ['files','commands']},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
+
+
+if __name__=='__main__':
+    main()
